about_short_description.short_description: OpenReplay is an open-source, self-hostable, session replay and product analytics platform.

product.name: Session Replay
product.description: A tool that records and replays user interactions within web applications to help understand user behavior and troubleshoot issues.

product.name: Product Analytics
product.description: A platform that analyzes user journeys, conversion funnels, trends, and heatmaps to measure product performance and user engagement.

product.name: Co-Browsing
product.description: A real-time collaborative feature that allows support agents to navigate and interact with users' sessions to assist and resolve issues.

product.name: DevTools
product.description: A developer toolkit integrated with session replay that provides detailed technical insights such as network activity, console logs, and error tracking.

product.name: Integrations & API
product.description: APIs and integrations that connect OpenReplay with backend logs, monitoring tools, and internal systems to enrich session data and export it.

product.name: kAI (AI Assistant)
product.description: An AI assistant that provides natural language insights on user behavior, technical issues, and product analytics using session data.
